summary: The proposal is missing a critical Abstract section and includes a non‑peer‑reviewed bibliography entry, both serious deficiencies. Several major issues—such as presenting a solution in the Problem section, a double‑verb objective, a missing AI‑transparency verification sentence, and an impermissible thesis‑writing task in the schedule—must be corrected before submission. Minor writing style and figure caption problems are also noted.

findings.title: Missing Abstract section
findings.description: The proposal does not contain an Abstract section, which is required.

findings.title: Bibliography contains non‑peer‑reviewed source
findings.description: The bibliography entry for the Keycloak Server Administration Guide is an online documentation resource, not a peer‑reviewed publication.

findings.title: Problem section presents a solution
findings.description: The Problem section should only describe the problem; it introduces a self‑service platform as a solution.

locations.quote: A **self-service platform** that arms the workflow engine of Keycloak with an expiry date at grant time would end this accumulation.

findings.title: Objective bullet uses double verbs
findings.description: The second objective bullet contains two verbs "Design and implement", which violates the rule that objectives must use a single verb.

findings.title: AI transparency statement missing verification sentence
findings.description: The AI transparency statement does not contain a sentence confirming that the author has carefully checked all AI‑generated text.

locations.quote: I used the following generative artificial intelligence (AI) tool while preparing this proposal…

findings.title: Schedule includes thesis‑writing task
findings.description: Iteration 7 lists "Write the thesis and prepare final presentation", which is prohibited for the schedule.

locations.quote: •   Iteration 7 (18–31 March): **Write the thesis** and prepare final presentation.

findings.title: Figure 2 caption is too brief
findings.description: The caption for Figure 2 is just "System Architecture", which is not sufficiently descriptive.

findings.title: Use of contractions
findings.description: The proposal contains contractions such as "doesn’t", which are prohibited.

locations.quote: The current process **doesn’t** scale and is the worst bottleneck of the chair.

findings.title: Use of superlative language
findings.description: The phrase "the worst bottleneck" uses a superlative, which should be avoided.

locations.quote: is the **worst** bottleneck of the chair.
